name: Direct-pair knuckle: K's follower arm (lug on link 1a, O5 roller) on a link-2 lobe plate - no rocker, rod or rod ends; roller and groove embodiments
lens: round7:direct-drive-knuckle (a) + spring-free groove variant (merged from groove-arm-knuckle-3r)
family: redundant 4R with a determined spare (cam-slaved knuckle), direct higher pair
verdict: DEAD at its kill gate: best fast near-touch 26.05 on Bench(60,160) (plain 26.05, reach 0.694, in band 0.863, contact 0.018) against the gate 15.5 and the judge's law-only bound 14.38 - the direct pair's metal costs >= 11.7 points, more than the rod drive it replaces (4.74). Groove best 95.51. The spec's geometry (arm aimed at J2) is an idle drive: pressure angle 90 deg at the onset.
limiter: Pressure angle forces the follower 18-30 mm from u2 and the low-gain law carries it to 27-46 mm, so the lobe plate is a disc swept around J2 whose outer 25-35 mm sits over skin 6-14 mm higher than under hub 2 (plane need 66-74 mm vs ring 63.4): plate 0-2 % in band, lug 0-32 %. Capping the follower radius (rho_max 24-28) keeps the plate at the ring level but then the lug collides with link 1b on 87-138 of 160 poses (they share the K-J2 corridor). Groove: the 93-deg dwell flange sweeps the body (plate need 177 mm).
note: Model docs/concepts/models/rim-lobe-arm-knuckle-3r.py on the winner's module (kit-rule B, phys q2 stop, near-touch, VModel checks, capK 6) with an exact spherical pair: P(t) = R(uK,-dK) p_arm, pitch C(t) = R(u2,-q2) P(t); gates pa <= 45 (relative-velocity form), lobe material toward u2, convex pitch radius >= rr+1, follower >= HUB_R+rr+1 off u2, lap check over every q2 from the fold stop through the law, rho_max (plate size cap). Metal: lug (8 mm strap, skin-fitted, 60-deg ramps), flat 3 mm plate (one level along u2, every lobe/slot sample), O5 x 3 follower; layering 'low' (lug bottom, follower up into the plate layer, plate = lug top + 1.2) or 'high' (spec: lug a layer over the plate); pairs LUG/PLATE/FOLL vs every hub (hub K with its cap), link, knee, pad, E. Search: 1 seed + 28 local + farm LHS 224 (emb, lay, kK, smhi, a1max, bk1, bk2, L_arm, a0, rr) + farm CMA (see sweeps). Red team: the 26.05 config keeps a pose whose plate ray runs through the body, so its plate floats at 148.5 mm (0 % in band): it is the 'drive metal out of the way' ceiling, not a buildable shape. Force closure not measured (moot).

mechanism.notes: roller embodiment: J1, K, J2, J3 O20 MR117-2RS pairs; lug on link 1a with an O2 Ti pin + MR52ZZ roller; 3 mm Ti lobe plate on link 2; K clock spring onto stop A; pin knee (2 sensed iglidur pins); the cam contact counted as a joint (rolling pair). Groove: no spring, a sliding pair instead of the rolling pair.
